_comment: Run hmp6 — BL-120, an INVESTIGATION that changes no code; deliverable is design/archive/bl120-attached-busy-investigation.md, committed to the task branch. The worker sits in an AgentTalk worktree at /tmp/att-op-hmp6 (branch task-op-hmp6), so design/backlog.md IS in the workdir — no external read needed (unlike hmp5, where the workdir was a client worktree). CAP CORRECTION (BL-117, 2026-08-06): cap.meter NO LONGER TERMINATES ANYTHING — demoted to a warning after it killed complete, verified work on hmp5 fourteen seconds after the worker committed. It stays MANDATORY to configure (the commission refuses missing-cap-meter), but cap.wallClockMs is the ONLY rail that stops a run. Set deliberately, NOT copied from hmp5: 3600000 ms (60 min) for a read-only investigation — tracing the busy/sessionStatus readers across ~5 source files, writing one design doc, committing. No build/test cycles, so no reason to exceed an hour; 60 min is generous-but-bounded. instance.orchestratorUrl is REQUIRED even with a startCommand (the client's start script takes it from THIS config and only parses mcpUrl from the backend's stdout; omitting it fails with 'createLauncherCore requires orchestratorUrl' — that is what killed hmp1's first attempt). The orchestrator is AgentTalk's backend, hence startCommand.cwd; the WORKER's workdir is the AgentTalk worktree. Paths are macOS: os.tmpdir() there is /var/folders/…, so the sandbox was created with an explicit root of /tmp and the workdir below must match. Recording path is distinct from every prior run (hmp1-5 used /tmp/att-op-hmpN-recording.json).
goal: Investigate backlog item BL-120 — setAgentBusyState(agent, true) is unreachable, so an attached agent's status never says busy — and write a design document at design/archive/bl120-attached-busy-investigation.md weighing its recorded options and recommending one, with reasons. Commit that document to your branch; change no code.
